facts.fact: ZCSRA says a web-based eCRVS platform and Sheha Mobile App, redeveloped from 2022, now carry birth registration in all 11 Zanzibar districts down to Sheha level.
ZCSRA says death registration, with births, marriages and divorces, is decentralised to Sheha level through the eCRVS platform in all 11 Zanzibar districts.

systems.platform: web-based platform and Sheha Mobile App
